## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set holds Invasive only [F1]; worklist flagged tier 2.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 1.00, OOD percentile 1.00 | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules; concept model links this to invasive · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce benign stroma; concept model links this to invasive · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Stromal infiltration score modestly raised · Validated
- **Tumor cell density** (regions 0, 4, 9) · context · 2,382 per mm², above 93% of reference images [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Case leans on mitoses (0/20 spot check), Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration was checked on a small test set (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18); 99% may be imprecise.
- Cell measurements cover only regions 0, 4 and 9; nine other regions are unmeasured.

## Check on the slide
1. **3** — Strongest for tumor-infiltrating stroma (19/20); confirm true stromal invasion.
2. **7, 10** — Lowest per-region invasive risk (87%, 80%); look for benign or in situ tissue.
3. **2** — Top region for confined-duct atypia (12/20, Weak); check for in situ component.
